name: jigar-ecosystem
description: Jigar EcoSystem — shaxsiy yordamchi (Jarvis): internet, xotira, eslatmalar, fayl, "Hey Jigar". Global'dan alohida.

scripts.build:mac: npm --prefix desktop run dist:mac && mkdir -p downloads && cp desktop/dist/Jigar-mac.dmg downloads/
scripts.build:win: npm --prefix desktop run dist:win && mkdir -p downloads && cp desktop/dist/Jigar-win.exe downloads/
scripts.build:android: cd mobile && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && mkdir -p ../../downloads && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../../downloads/Jigar-android.apk
scripts.build:win-zip: npm --prefix desktop run dist:win-zip && mkdir -p downloads && cp desktop/dist/Jigar-win.zip downloads/
